Sparse direct solver

Source: R/sparse_linalg.R
experimental_sparse_linalg_spsolve.Rd

Port of jax.experimental.sparse.linalg.spsolve: solves A x = b for a square matrix A given by its CSR buffers. As upstream on CPU, the solve runs on the host: a sparse LU factorization with the Matrix package (a dense solve for complex data or without Matrix), so tol and reorder (GPU solver options) are only validated. It works under jit() and is differentiable with respect to data and b; batching with vmap() is not supported.

Usage

experimental_sparse_linalg_spsolve(
  data,
  indices,
  indptr,
  b,
  tol = 1e-06,
  reorder = 1L
)

Arguments

data

The stored values of the CSR matrix.

indices

The 0-based column indices.

indptr

The row pointer array, of length n + 1.

b

The right hand side, of length n.

tol

Singularity tolerance of the GPU solver.

reorder

Fill-in reducing reordering scheme of the GPU solver (0 to 3).

Value

The solution, with the dtype and size of b.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
m <- experimental_sparse_CSR$fromdense(matrix(c(4, 1, 0, 1, 3, 0, 0, 0, 2), 3))
experimental_sparse_linalg_spsolve(m$data, m$indices, m$indptr, jnp_array(c(1, 2, 3)))
} # }
